title: Review the trusted runner-path boundary for direct Node Vitest verification
outcome: The runner path/package/config trust assumed by registered direct Node Vitest verification is explicit, with any desired confinement implemented consistently with existing test-runner routes.
acceptance: The installed-runner trust model and relative/absolute runner/config path behavior are documented or deliberately narrowed, without implying package-byte attestation that the host does not perform.
Any changed path-admission boundary has behavioral positive and refusal coverage and preserves supported Windows focused Vitest execution.
